oracle.method: finite-sample F critical values by numerical integration
oracle.independence_basis: The F(1,n-2) 0.95 critical values for n=150,300,600 were computed with Python standard-library lgamma and Simpson integration of the Student t density with bisection on its 0.975 quantile, using no production incomplete-beta, F quantile or generator. The harness was not retained. The structural effect 2 is the declared DGP coefficient. Measurement tests that use these pins are ignored until calibration.
oracle.historical_exposure: The computing harness is not retained; historical author exposure is unrecorded and remains unknown.
